## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [善熹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%86%B9) Shànxī is a critical Huáyán-school engagement with [湛然](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B9%9B%E7%84%B6) Zhànrán's *[Jīngāng pī 金剛錍](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0025)* (T1932) — the *Diamond Scalpel*, the famous Tiāntái-school treatise that argued for the doctrine of *fǎ rì zhī yǔ wúqíng* 法日之雨無情 ("the doctrine that even non-sentient beings have Buddha-nature"). The Huáyán-school challenge to Zhànrán's Tiāntái doctrine — articulated here by Shànxī — is one of the principal documents of mature Sòng Buddhist inter-school doctrinal disputation.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to [善熹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%86%B9) Shànxī's mature period, c. 1170 – 1200 CE; the bracket adopted here reflects this window. The doctrinal substance — the Tiāntái-versus-Huáyán dispute on Buddha-nature in non-sentients — is one of the principal Sòng-Yuán scholastic controversies between the two doctrinal traditions.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1018) collection.
